canon_ref.note: Same day as 1.19R. Day is a guess, as in 1.19R. Deltas are design values.

b1.ryoka_warned_by_fals.summary: At the Runner's Guild in Remendia, Ryoka reports the Goblins and eyes an odd request: twenty gold just to visit the High Passes. Garia talks her into a joint run. Fals, speaking for the other Runners, tells her to leave Magnolia's jobs to others. She runs to Wales for the night.

system.name: [Barefoot Runner]
system.note: She blocks the level messages each night; the text cuts off mid-word, so whether she ever takes the class is not shown.
